statusTickerZh: // 區域一 枯萎荒野：極端乾旱持續中 // 雷公現蹤：荒涼海灘懸崖頂端 // 閃耀空島：摩天大樓 4F 建設已開放 // 真新鎮：伊布遭遇已解鎖 // 夢幻壁畫：27 塊石板謎題可解鎖於地下通道

locations.descriptionEn: The first region you arrive in, suffering from extreme drought. Complete the 'Yawn Up A Storm' quest: use Squirtle's Water Gun to water the cracked earth, trigger rainfall, and rescue the buried Onix. Rebuild the Pokémon Center to establish your base. A hidden mural with 27 Unown-shaped slots is concealed in an underground passage — access it by smashing a cracked wall north of the Pokémon Center and cutting through a metal net with upgraded Slash.
locations.descriptionZh: 旅程的起點，飽受極端乾旱侵襲。完成主線任務「打個哈欠喚來暴雨」：學習傑尼龜的「水槍」技能，逐步滋潤龜裂大地，引發降雨拯救深埋地下的大岩蛇。重建寶可夢中心以建立據點。北方地下通道深處隱藏著一面有 27 個「未知圖騰」形插槽的壁畫——從寶可夢中心右側碎磚路向北，以碎岩技能擊穿裂岩後，再以強化版居合斬切開金屬網即可抵達。

locations.descriptionEn: A waterlogged, dark coastline overrun with trash. Key steps: (1) Use dirt or stone floor tiles to patch the broken fountain and stop flooding. (2) Build Meowth a shelter with a Mushroom Lamp to restore calm. (3) Attract Poliwag to clear mud heaps, then build a trash collection station to recruit Trubbish for iron ore and shower construction. (4) 'Brighten Things Up!' megaquest: find and repair the beach windmill, lighthouse water wheel, and charging station. Craft power poles to wire the network together and have Fire-type Pokémon run the generator at full power — illuminating the whole town. Climb the clifftop afterward for a dialogue encounter with the legendary Raikou.
locations.descriptionZh: 水患肆虐、陰暗且充滿垃圾的海岸線。主線流程：(1) 以泥土或石地板方塊修補破損噴泉，阻斷水流。(2) 為喵喵建造附有蘑菇燈的避難所。(3) 吸引波加曼清除泥堆，再建造垃圾收集站吸引破破袋取得鐵礦，建造淋浴間。(4)「Brighten things up!」大型發電工程：修復海灘風車、燈塔水車與充電站，製作電線桿串聯電網，讓火系寶可夢全力維持發電，點亮整座城鎮。完成後攀爬懸崖頂端，觸發與傳說寶可夢「雷公」的初次對話。

locations.descriptionEn: A vast ruin network buried under volcanic ash. Key quests: (1) Rescue trapped Chef Dente — build a Bread Oven, bake wheat bread, and eat it to gain the strength to break his chains. (2) Upgrade Rock Smash — lure Magmar (鴨嘴火獸) to the furnace to smelt copper ore into copper ingots, craft a Frying Pan, cook and eat a Burger Patty to power up Ditto's Rock Smash ability, unlocking high-grade ore veins and pure metal blocks. (3) Mining — use strengthened Rock Smash to extract gold ore, crystal shards, and lava rocks for later endgame constructions.
locations.descriptionZh: 被火山灰掩埋的龐大遺跡網絡。主線任務：(1) 救出主廚 Dente——建造麵包爐、烤製小麥麵包並食用，獲得擊斷鎖鏈的力量。(2) 強化碎岩——吸引鴨嘴火獸（Magmar）至熔煉爐，將銅礦冶煉成銅錠，製作平底鍋，烹調並食用漢堡排，強化百變怪的碎岩能力，解鎖高純度礦脈與金屬大礦。(3) 採礦——以強化碎岩開採金礦、水晶碎片及熔岩岩石，用於後期終局建設。

locations.descriptionEn: Floating garbage islands and an unfinished skyscraper. Key progression: (1) Build a Waterside Boat habitat to attract Dragonite and learn Glide for island traversal. (2) Meet Tinkmaster (巨鍛匠) — exchange concrete and iron ingots for Special Gears to craft Lift Platforms. (3) 'Rebuild the Huge Building' — reconstruct floor by floor, each taking 1 real-time hour. 2F: 25 concrete, 10 glass, 5 Pokémetal, 10 iron ingots. 3F: 25 concrete, 10 glass, 10 glowstone, 15 copper ingots (requires escorting Chef Dente). 4F: 40 concrete, 15 glass, 10 paper, 10 bricks, 20 lumber (requires fetching Peakychu from Bleak Beach). Reaching the rooftop after 4F triggers the Mewtwo encounter.
locations.descriptionZh: 由漂浮垃圾島與未完工摩天大樓組成的空中世界。主線流程：(1) 建造水邊小艇棲息地吸引快龍，習得「滑翔」技能穿越各島。(2) 與巨鍛匠交易——以混凝土與鐵錠換取特殊齒輪製作升降平台。(3)「重建巨大建築」——逐層施工，每層耗費現實時間 1 小時。2F：25 混凝土、10 玻璃、5 寶可金屬、10 鐵錠。3F：25 混凝土、10 玻璃、10 發光石、15 銅錠（需護送主廚 Dente）。4F：40 混凝土、15 玻璃、10 紙張、10 磚塊、20 木材（需前往荒涼海灘護送 Peakychu）。完成 4F 後步上屋頂即觸發超夢（Mewtwo）相遇。

locations.descriptionEn: Unlocked after completing all four main regions. The ultimate sandbox challenge focuses on restoring Eevee and all 8 eeveelutions — each requiring a unique food item unlocked through specific gameplay milestones (e.g., Vaporeon needs 10 water habitats; Umbreon requires 300 road blocks placed and only appears at night). Three island peaks contain yellow Poké Ball blueprints for the three legendary bird altars: Altar of Flame (Moltres — 50 copper ingots, 50 gold ingots, 50 lava rocks, 10 Pokémetal), Abandoned Power Plant (Zapdos — 50 copper ingots, 50 iron ingots, 50 sea glass shards, 50 bricks, 10 Pokémetal; needs 15 Pokémon with Build/Generate/Crush/Fly specialties), and Freezing Chambers (Articuno — 50 stone, 50 ice blocks, 10 crystal shards, 10 Pokémetal).
locations.descriptionZh: 完成四大主線區域後解鎖的終局沙盒地帶。核心挑戰為復育伊布與其八種進化型態，每種需解鎖獨特食物（如水伊布需建造 10 個水系棲息地；月亮伊布需鋪設 300 塊道路且僅夜間生成）。島嶼三大高峰各藏有黃色精靈球內的建築藍圖，對應傳說三神鳥祭壇：烈焰祭壇（火焰鳥 50 銅錠、50 金錠、50 熔岩岩石、10 寶可金屬）、廢棄發電廠（閃電鳥 50 銅錠、50 鐵錠、50 海玻璃碎片、50 磚塊、10 寶可金屬；需 15 隻涵蓋建造/發電/粉碎/飛行專長的寶可夢）、冰結之室（急凍鳥 50 石頭、50 冰塊、10 水晶碎片、10 寶可金屬）。

locations.descriptionEn: Accessible by entrusting a Pokémon doll to Drifloon. The destination island is randomly generated. To encounter Raikou: enter the Pikachu Doll Dream Island (Ocean variant), navigate deep into the cave, and use Burger Patty–powered Rock Smash to clear metal blocks. Successfully recruiting Raikou dramatically boosts your region's environment level. Other Johto Legendary Beasts (Entei, Suicune) can be found in other doll variants. Recruiting the third beast unlocks the Clear Bell recipe, summoning Ho-Oh.
locations.descriptionZh: 將寶可夢娃娃交給飄飄球（Drifloon）即可前往隨機生成的夢境群島。遭遇雷公路線：進入「皮卡丘娃娃夢境島（海洋型）」，深入洞穴深處，以漢堡排強化後的碎岩擊破金屬方塊，成功招募雷公後可大幅提升區域環境等級。其他城都三聖獸（炎帝、水君）存在於不同娃娃的夢境島中。成功招募第三隻聖獸後，解鎖「透明鈴鐺」製作配方，可召喚鳳王（Ho-Oh）。
